claim_boundary: fixed-geometry conductor roots for water/methanol molecules, NOT two liquid solvents; local/root-basin evidence only; no global uniqueness, force, full chemical accuracy or release admission
geometry_policy: existing input geometry rounded through float32 and back to float64 by stock stationary core; record exact canonical coordinates

metric.basis: existing FixedChargeCoordinates Helmert charge basis + Cartesian reordered dipoles
metric.field_scale: dual to source metric: 1 eV/e and 1 eV/(e Angstrom)

model_binding: new private immutable checkpoint spec passed directly; no registry or production source changes

molecules.geometry_source: committed FreeSolv-20 v3 profile bundle geometries/mobley_1636752.xyz
molecules.name: methanol

record_policy: save both molecules and all declared seed outcomes incl failures; save every response/map FD electronic state and raw H/J before any symmetry processing
seed_policy: stock evaluate is primary; independent seed driver reuses stock next_fixed_point_density and validators; never substitutes a seed as a fabricated energy gradient
stability_definition: On T=-sym(K) positive support use C=I+sqrt(T)^T sym(H) sqrt(T); retain raw J=H K and independently FD F(c); never test positive definiteness of saddle L
stability_resolution: report all three steps; primary finest step; joint margin must exceed last-two-step C operator difference and Gamma antisymmetry as a diagnostic resolution check, not a rigorous error bound
